$comment: The one API contract Nook's app, Worker and local stub all have to agree on. Read by test/backend_routing_test.dart on the Flutter side and server/test/contract.test.mjs on the service side, so the two cannot drift apart without a test failing. This file is documentation that fails the build when it stops being true.
requestShape: An Anthropic Messages API request body, unchanged. The service attaches the credential; the client sends none.
metadataRequestShape: {"url": "<a public post URL>", "avatar": true}. Reads a post's public Open Graph tags and keyless oEmbed server-side, because a static site cannot: it has an origin and this does not. Needs no key and spends nothing. Answers {platform, url, canonicalUrl, title, caption, hashtags, creator, creatorHandle, creatorUrl, creatorAvatarUrl, thumbnailUrl, mediaType, fetched, reason}. fetched:false with a reason is a real answer — a private, deleted or login-gated post — not an error.
toolsAreBodyFields: These are tool names inside the request body, not routes. The service refuses a body that does not name one of them, which is what stops it being usable as a general chat endpoint.
toolsOrder: Extraction first, planning second. server/test/app_contract.test.mjs indexes this array; test/backend_routing_test.dart asserts ClaudeExtractor.toolName and ClaudeItineraryGenerator.toolName are both in it.
